newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Ecotek sets Italian joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Ecotek sets Italian joint venture.

text.p: Thermo Ecotek Corp said Wednesday it had formed a joint venture with Marcegaglia Group of Mantova, Italy, to develop, own, and operate biomass-fueled electric power facilities in that country.

In an effort to promote the development of biomass-fueled electric power generation facilities, the Italian government has passed legislation authorizing a price subsidy for Italy's ENEL utility company to purchase power from biomass-fueled plants. On behalf of the joint venture, Thermo Ecotek has begun the preliminary evaluation of 10 projects, seven of which have already been approved by the Italian government for its subsidy program. Additionally, several of the projects are expected to qualify for European Union grants, covering a portion of the capital costs.
Thermo Ecotek is a public subsidiary of Thermo Electron Corp.
Marcegaglia Group is a large, privately held manufacturer of steel pipe and tubing.
